methodology.name: 스니덩 카드 동일 초기금액 참고지수
methodology.membershipGate: prior-cutoff actual price availability and seasoning
methodology.membershipReview: monthly first calendar day; cutoff previous day
methodology.conditionAdditionPolicy: none: conditions fixed at first product admission
methodology.exitPolicy: only explicitly verified scope/deletion event with evidence
methodology.formula: V(t)=sum(q_i*p_i(t)); I(t)=V(t)/D(t). For equal-amount-fixed, q_i=1/(K*p_i(effective admission date)), allocating 1/K initial amount to each of K pinned conditions. At entry/verified exit: D_new=D_old*V_new(t)/V_old(t) using identical effective-date prices. Previously admitted quantities stay fixed.
methodology.productQuantityMeaning: one virtual initial monetary unit per product, split 1/K across K eligible condition grades; buy q=1/(K*actual admission-window price) and keep q fixed; not physical circulating supply
methodology.priceDefinition: median of actual positive SAME-condition prices in the trailing valuation window; absent windows use explicitly labelled own-condition-anchor model estimates
methodology.predictionRule: brand-specific locked native-price-anchor or window-price-anchor; selected only by price blackout error
methodology.predictorSelectionPrerequisite: native quote and factor anchor dates must match; window-price-anchor is a diagnostic benchmark only because it fails the temporal-anchor invariant
methodology.baselineSelection: explicit 2024-01-01 operating baseline; earliest archived one-card days are not a broad market baseline

tests.stressSelectionRule: final product partition only; actual complete pinned-condition q-price path since admission; first maximum divided by first preceding minimum >=10, current/peak<=0.8; current actual complete and every condition has a native quote before the 30-day blackout

pokemon.partitionRule: sha256(dynamic-card-index-validation-v1:brand:productId) first byte parity; development even, final validation odd
pokemon.independenceMeaning: development and final held-out target product IDs are disjoint; shared archived market context and retrospective fits, not external future validation
pokemon.tailThresholdMeaning: product sum(initialQuantity * current actual price) divided by sum(initialQuantity * actual admission-window entryPrice); equal-amount-fixed initial sum is one monetary unit

priceEvidenceMethodology.windowBounds: inclusive endpoint minus 29 calendar days through endpoint
priceEvidenceMethodology.conditionPrice: median of positive actual recorded prices within each window
priceEvidenceMethodology.productMultiple: arithmetic mean of recent/baseline condition-price ratios; equal weights among that product's baseline-observed conditions
priceEvidenceMethodology.arithmeticMultiple: arithmetic mean of compared product multiples; equal initial amount per product
priceEvidenceMethodology.geometricMultiple: exponential of mean log compared product multiple
priceEvidenceMethodology.comparisonScope: all baseline-observed products; compare only products with every baseline-observed condition also actually observed in recent window
priceEvidenceMethodology.missingPricePolicy: exclude incomplete products from this endpoint comparison; never zero, carry or chain returns
priceEvidenceMethodology.newConditionsPolicy: conditions absent from baseline window do not enter the comparison
priceEvidenceMethodology.selectionLimitation: endpoint observation availability can select surviving products; coverage is disclosed, not a full-market return
priceEvidenceMethodology.peakSelection: highest applied dynamic daily index on or after baseline
priceEvidenceMethodology.indexPathMeaning: existing daily TPD model points; not a direct-price arithmetic or median time series

limitations: All printed languages are eligible; products lacking the past-only price-evidence gate are not silently assigned prices.
Virtual quantities define price weights, not circulating quantities or market capitalization.
Membership changes are linked with a neutral divisor; missing observations alone never remove a holding.
Recorded chart amounts have no independently verified per-copy quantity normalization.
A current catalog does not prove recovery of delisted historical products; no historical-universe completeness claim.
Current-day observations are provisional; source corrections may revise prior calculations.
